fusions.name: Musk Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a stinging musk that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. It has a 40% chance to leave the target [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fouled Waters
fusions.desc: Releases a cone of foul brine 6 tiles ahead that deals 24 damage that ignores resistances to everything caught in it and leaves each [Exposed] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Coating
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and the attacker is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lingering Notice
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You also gain 10% poison resistance.
